name: How does AKN Design Group incorporate window glass replacement into a whole-home remodel?

mainEntity.name: How does AKN Design Group incorporate window glass replacement into a whole-home remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: During a whole-home remodel, AKN Design Group integrates window glass replacement by assessing your home's architectural style, energy performance goals, and overall design aesthetic. We coordinate the selection of appropriate glass types—such as insulated, low-emissivity (Low-E), or specialized impact-resistant glass—to complement the new design and meet permit requirements. Our managed process ensures that window selections align seamlessly with new framing, exterior finishes, and interior design elements, enhancing both functionality and beauty.
acceptedAnswer.description: AKN Design Group integrates window glass replacement into whole-home remodels by aligning glass types with architectural style, energy goals, and design, coordinating seamlessly with other project elements.
